title: Schedule of Renewal, Nonrenewal and Underwriting Periods, Cardinal Personal Auto Policy
content:
The periods below, counted in calendar days, govern when a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy renewal offer is issued, how far ahead a company nonrenewal notice must be mailed, how long after an expiration for unpaid renewal a late renewal payment is still accepted, and how long after inception new business may be cancelled on underwriting grounds.

| Period, calendar days | Cardinal Auto Essential | Cardinal Auto Basic | Cardinal Auto Standard | Cardinal Auto Plus | Cardinal Auto Preferred | Cardinal Auto Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Renewal offer issued this many days before term expiration | 30 | 30 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 60 |
| Least days between mailing a nonrenewal notice and term expiration | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |
| Late renewal payment accepted up to this many days after expiration for unpaid renewal | 10 | 10 | 15 | 15 | 30 | 30 |
| New business underwriting cancellation available up to this many days after the original inception date | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A Cardinal Auto Standard term expiring on day X receives its renewal offer 45 days before day X; a Cardinal Auto Premier term receives it 60 days before.
- A Cardinal Auto Basic policy that expired for unpaid renewal can take a late renewal payment for 10 calendar days after expiration; a Cardinal Auto Preferred policy for 30.
- The nonrenewal notice period is 45 days on every package.
